📝 MS Word Shortcut Keys in Hindi

MS Word mein mouse ki jagah keyboard use karke apna kaam 2 guna tez karo. Yeh sabhi shortcuts Word 2010, 2016, 2019, 2021 aur Microsoft 365 mein chalte hain.

Is page par 43 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

MS Word Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutKya hota haiCopy
Ctrl + APoora document select karo
Ctrl + BText ko Bold karo
Ctrl + IText ko Italic (tircha) karo
Ctrl + UText ke neeche Underline lagao
Ctrl + CSelected text Copy karo
Ctrl + XSelected text Cut karo
Ctrl + VCopy/Cut kiya text Paste karo
Ctrl + ZPichla kaam Undo karo
Ctrl + YUndo kiya kaam wapas lao (Redo)
Ctrl + SDocument Save karo
F12Save As – naye naam se save karo
Ctrl + NNaya blank document kholo
Ctrl + OPurana document kholo (Open)
Ctrl + WDocument band karo
Ctrl + PPrint ya PDF save karo
Ctrl + FDocument mein shabd dhoondo (Find)
Ctrl + HShabd dhoond kar badlo (Replace)
Ctrl + GKisi page number par jao (Go To)
Ctrl + EText ko Center mein lao
Ctrl + LText ko Left align karo
Ctrl + RText ko Right align karo
Ctrl + JText ko Justify karo (dono taraf barabar)
Ctrl + MParagraph ka Indent badhao
Ctrl + Shift + MParagraph ka Indent kam karo
Ctrl + 1Single line spacing
Ctrl + 2Double line spacing
Ctrl + 51.5 line spacing
Ctrl + Shift + >Font size bada karo
Ctrl + Shift + <Font size chhota karo
Ctrl + ]Font size 1 point badhao
Ctrl + [Font size 1 point ghatao
Ctrl + DFont dialog box kholo
Shift + F3Capital/small letters badlo (Change Case)
Ctrl + =Subscript (H₂O jaisa)
Ctrl + Shift + =Superscript (x² jaisa)
Ctrl + KHyperlink (link) lagao
Ctrl + EnterNaya page shuru karo (Page Break)
Ctrl + HomeDocument ki shuruaat par jao
Ctrl + EndDocument ke aakhir mein jao
F7Spelling aur Grammar check karo
Alt + Shift + DAaj ki date daalo
Alt + Shift + TAbhi ka time daalo
Alt + XCode ko emoji/symbol mein badlo (jaise 1F980 → 🦀)
